boundary_evidence.start: ICRect starts at $4148A8 and ABTitleStr at $4148B0. The alert body references both through PC addressing. InitDialogs begins immediately after them at $4148B2.
boundary_evidence.end: GetCurRect copies two longwords and returns at $415586. Munger begins at $415588.

restored_equates.name: EvtLink
restored_equates.reason: The ROM StdEntry LINK instruction allocates 76 bytes. The later source extends the frame with color and text-state locals.

edits.description: Restored the complete contiguous Dialog Manager, including ICRect and ABTitleStr before InitDialogs and the final GetCurRect routine. Retained the released header, history through November 1985, register assignments, applicable routine contracts, equates, and matching comments.

Matched operations within corresponding released routines using resolved equates and operand values. The ROM determines branch destinations, instruction widths, direct calls, stack frames, and encodings. A recorded source operation may use a different encoding or branch destination in the later source. Omitted comments for removed color, help, resource error checks, and later TextEdit paths.

Restored AlertFilter, CouldDialog, CouldAlert, FreeDialog, FreeAlert, CmnStuff, and the ScanAD resource load/free paths from the ROM. The released history records their removal. Reconstruction notes identify these bodies; descriptive labels in the restored paths do not claim to reproduce lost original names.

Restored the 76-byte local frame ending at theEvent. NewDialog allocates a 170-byte dialog record, opens a monochrome window, creates its TextEdit record, and initializes the item list. The ROM tests ClaimEvent results without later nil-window guards.

Restored Zounds with its A1 return address and D2 beep count. ModalDialog selects AlertFilter for a nil filter pointer. AlertFilter handles Return and Enter, checks the default item type, flashes an enabled default button, and returns the item number.

Restored direct master pointer lock and purge-bit changes before 32-bit addressing support. CouldDialog and CouldAlert load resources and clear their purge bits. FreeDialog and FreeAlert set purge bits only where resource attributes permit. CmnStuff gets WDEF 0 without later ROMMapInsert writes.

Restored the original monochrome icon and picture initialization, direct TextEdit calls, item visibility tests, scrolling setup, and handle disposal. CloseDialog retains the old direct disposal sequence still present as commented code in the released source.

Restored the original DoStatic citation loop that the released source replaced with ReplaceCitations. It clones the item text, scans for ^0 through ^3, replaces citations through Munger, and draws with left justification. It advances past a caret that does not introduce a citation.

Preserved the ROM DispItem branch to DCtrlItem, whose body returns without disposing a control. The released history records this bug and the later correction to RCtrlItem. The reconstructed source does not apply that later fix.

Replaced later build includes with required released equates. Used OPWORD for A-line traps and explicit PC addressing for code and static-data references. All instructions are assembled; the only data directives reproduce the released icon rectangle and empty alert title.

reconstruction_notes.4278496: Zounds retains the older A1 return address and D2 beep count. Each beep uses duration 3 and a six-tick delay.
reconstruction_notes.4278520: AlertFilter was removed from the released source. This ROM body handles Return and Enter, tests the default item, flashes an enabled default button, and returns its item number.
reconstruction_notes.4278646: The ROM follows the monochrome alert path without later resource error checks or color tables.
reconstruction_notes.4278984: The ROM allocates a 170-byte dialog record when needed and creates one monochrome window and TextEdit record.
reconstruction_notes.4279136: The ROM tests the window returned by ClaimEvent directly. It predates the later nil-window guards.
reconstruction_notes.4279258: The ROM selects AlertFilter when the caller supplies no filter. It idles the edit field and requests events with mask $017F.
reconstruction_notes.4279454: The ROM disposes the TextEdit handle directly. The later source creates an empty text handle and calls TEDispose.
reconstruction_notes.4279642: CouldDialog and CouldAlert were reduced to obsolete-call stubs in the released source. The ROM restores their resource loading and nonpurgeable state changes.
reconstruction_notes.4279712: The ROM sets the lock bit in the master pointer directly and returns the resource pointer in A1.
reconstruction_notes.4279732: FreeDialog and FreeAlert restore purgeable state for resources whose attributes allow it. The released source removed these bodies.
reconstruction_notes.4279796: CmnStuff locks the item list during ScanAD, then gets WDEF 0 for the caller. The ROM predates the later ROM map insertion.
reconstruction_notes.4280524: The ROM retains the ScanAD free and load paths removed from the released source. Controls use CNTL and CDEF resources; icons and pictures use ICON and PICT.
reconstruction_notes.4280614: This ROM helper sets the master pointer purge bit only when GetResAttrs reports the purgeable attribute.
reconstruction_notes.4280674: The ROM initializes monochrome icon and picture items through their shared GetResource path.
reconstruction_notes.4280928: The ROM clones the item text, substitutes citations ^0 through ^3 with ParamText strings, and draws the result with left justification. The released source delegates citation replacement to another routine.
reconstruction_notes.4281066: The ROM branches to DCtrlItem for controls, which returns without disposing them. The released history records the later correction of this branch.
reconstruction_notes.4281468: The ROM configures the original TextEdit record directly and enables automatic scrolling. Later text-style and international-justification paths are absent.

verification.method: Called Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py verify_module in an independent temporary directory. The verifier assembled for MC68000, linked at the ROM address, checked entry points and relocations, and compared every emitted byte.
verification.scope: The entire emitted span matches the ROM. MPW assembly has not been run. Byte equality does not establish original source formatting or original names for reconstructed labels.
